cases.plan_item: BUG-861 characterisation (R08 round 1 fails on Civil 3.0.75)
cases.expected: Control round says 'Everything has been redone'. Then three rounds: draw a line, U, blind real-mouse click on pit P3, wait 12 s, REDO. On 3.0.75 round 1 is expected to say 'Nothing to redo' and rounds 2 and 3 'Everything has been redone' (the R08 result). The probe records what happens, it does not judge CE.
cases.why_not_unit: Whether REDO survives depends on what happens in a real AutoCAD undo stack in the seconds after a pick.
not_automated: This is a probe for the R08 question only; it is not a feature test and is never accepted.
